title: @media, @supports, @container organization
learningObjectives: Explain @media, @supports, @container organization and organise styles for maintainability.

understand.concept: CSS at-rules can be organised so responsive conditions, feature support, and component-size conditions remain readable. @media responds to media features, @supports checks CSS feature support, and @container responds to a query container. Keep related enhancements close to the component or organise them by clear project conventions.
understand.whyItMatters: Unstructured conditional CSS becomes hard to debug as a project grows. A clear approach makes it easier to find which condition controls a rule and how the baseline behaves.
understand.analogy: These at-rules are different kinds of gates: environment, feature availability, and component container size.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; CSS cascade, inheritance, and conditional rules follow the formal cascade and at-rule processing model.

explain.narrative: The card has baseline styles, then media, support, and container enhancements. The conditions serve different purposes.
